text:
ENERĞİ AL-YAWM AL-AAMA
Tamtamât al-falak al-yawm tahmil li-mawalid burj al-thawr taqatan ījābiyyah 'amīqah wa thabātah al-ma'hūd. Al-yawm yumthil nuqtah tahawwul jamilah nahwa ta'zīz al-istiqrār al-dākhilī wa al-khārijī, haythu tash'ur bi-annah al-umūr tasīr wifqa mā turīd. Al-jaww al-'āmm yumtazaj bil-hudu' wa al-wa'ī al-mushrif, mimmā yumakkiruka min ru'yat al-umur bi-wudu' shafshāf. Rūhātuka al-yawm mā'ilah lil-bithāq al-nafsī wa al-bithāq al-ijtima'ī, wa satujid nafsaka tastamti'u bi-absaṭ al-tafāsīl al-yawmiyyah bi-shaghaf shadīd.

AL-'ISHQ WA AL-'ALĀQĀT
Li-al-murtabiṭīn min mawālīd al-thawr, al-yawm huwa fursatun thahabiyyah li-ta'zīz al-rawābiṭ al-'āṭifiyyah wa al-taqarrub akthar min al-sharīk 'abr hiwār hādī' wa amīq yuzīlu ayyu labas sābiq. Ammā al-'udhrāb wa al-bahhathūn 'an al-hubb, fa-al-falak yumhid al-tarīq li-liqā' ghayr mutawaqqa' qad yughayyir majrā al-qalb wa yahtaqun bi-masha'ir sādiqah wa dafi'ah. La tutarjad nafsaka lil-'ajalah fi al-masha'ir, fa-al-waqt yasmah laka bi-binā' asās matīn wa dā'im ya'tamid 'alā al-thiqah al-mutabādalah.

AL-'AMAL WA AL-KARIYAR
Fi majāl al-'amal, tatallaq ya mawlūd al-thawr bi-quwwat mulāhazatika wa sabrika al-ladhī lā yunfad, wa huma al-sifatān allatīnatā tammayizānaka da'iman. Qad tataqallā yawman mashhūdan bi-al-injazāt al-maliwshah al-latī tatarrakku intibā'an ījābiyan 'inda al-ru'asā' aw al-zumlā'. Istarji' fursatak al-yawm li-taqdīm afkār jadīdah, fa-al-bi'ah al-mihaniyyah hawlaka musta'iddah tamāman li-qubūl ru'yatika al-wāqi'iyyah wa al-mustadāmah.

AL-MĀL WA AL-BARAKAH
Al-wad' al-mālī ya'rifu istiqraran malhuzan al-yawm, ma'a imkāniyyat husul 'alā makāsib ghayr mutawaqqa'ah aw farah mālī basīt yūsi'u al-sadr. Hunāk mayl tabi'ī ladayka lil-tawzīf al-dhakī wa al-idkhār al-mustaqbalī, wa huwa qarār sahīh jiddan fi hādha al-waqt bi-adh-dhāt. Ishta'i ma tahfujuhu hajiqan wa lā tusrif fī al-kamāliyyāt al-ghayr dharūriyyah, fa-al-barakah ta'tī ma'a al-tadbīr al-hasan wa al-shukr al-mustamirr.

AL-SIHHHA WA AL-TAQAH
Sihhatuka al-badaniyyah wa al-nafsiyyah fi ahsan halatiha al-yawm, shart an tuhāfiẓ 'alā al-tawāzun bayna al-juhd al-mabdhūl wa al-rāhah al-lāzimah. Unsa nafsaka bi-ba'd al-anwā' al-riyādiyyah al-khafiffah mithl al-mashy fi al-hawa' al-talq aw mumārasat altammrināt al-istirkhā'. Inna al-tadhwīq al-dhihnī qad yahtaāj ilā qalīl min al-hudū', fa-uqjuh nafsaka bi-sama' al-mūsīqā al-hādiah aw al-julus fi makān tabi'ī sājin.

AL-ITTISĀL WA AL-MUHĪT
Al-wasat al-ijtimā'i hawlaka yamla'uhu al-da'm wa al-mahabbah, fa-al-a'ilah wa al-asdiqa' yabhasūn 'an quurbika li-annahum yajidūna fīka al-malja' wa al-rahat. Qad tatلقى da'watan lijiā' ijtimā'i dafi' yu'addidu al-nifas wa yun'ish al-ruwah, fa-la tarfudhu. Tasliyat al-nas wa al-istiqa' min tajarribihim sa-tudīfu ilā yawmika bahjah wa ma'āni jadīdah jamīlah.

NASĪHAT AL-YAWM
Kun thābitan ka-al-jibāl, fa-inna al-sabr huwa miftāhu kulli faraj, wa lā tansā an tastamti'u bi-kulll lahzah basītah yumaddiduhā laka al-qadar al-yawm.

TAFĀSĪL AL-YAWM
Al-raqm al-hazīz: 6. Al-lawn al-hazīz: Al-akhdar al-zaytuni al-dafi'. Al-burj al-mutawāfiq: Burj al-Jady.
